## Topics

### Prediction

The purpose of Machine Learning Models is to predict new outcomes ($Y$) from given data. This is achieved my constructing the function $f$ that predicts $Y$:

$$
Y = f(X;\theta)
$$

where $X$ is the new data obtained and $\theta$ are the parameters that dictate how a predefined model^[There are models that relax this assumption.] $f$ behaves.

For the purposes of this class, there are two types of predictions: Regressiona and Classification.
